lines.speaker: archivist
lines.text: The Origin network has found a dormant relay beneath the ruins. Restore power, retrieve its archive, and hold the signal when the Foundry comes looking.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.text: Relay found. Restore a generator, then pull the archive before the Foundry triangulates us.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.text: The basin is marked Foundry. Take the metal anyway. Their outpost is the claim.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.text: The old road still sings. Walk it. Recover every fragment.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.text: Six Sentinels. That is the escort minimum. The corridor is a kill box.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.text: Energy is gone. Raise three generators or the Core dies in the dark.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.text: They walled the archive. Reach Singularity, then tear the fortress down.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.text: Map every node. If Lattice finishes the rewrite, we lose the network.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.text: This is the last archive. Reach Singularity, then end their Core.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: Local grid is live. Archive access unlocked.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.text: The archive is ours. Hold this ground. They will come.

lines.speaker: foundry
lines.text: Origin salvage is Foundry property. Vacate the relay.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.text: First signal is stable. We can rebuild from this.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.text: The Foundry has claimed the nearest industrial reserve. Rebuild the economy, seize contested salvage, and break their outposts.

lines.speaker: foundry
lines.text: This reserve is scheduled. Leave the wreckage.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: Foundry raid inbound from the eastern towers.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.text: Relay fragments are broadcasting from the old road. Find them before the Lattice turns their signal against us.

lines.speaker: lattice
lines.text: Your map is incomplete. Stay on your side of the grid.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: Relay fragments aligned. Data yield increasing.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.text: An archive convoy must cross the silent grid. Build an escort force and keep the transfer alive.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: Transfer window open. Hold both ends of the road.

lines.speaker: foundry
lines.text: Convoy sighted. Cut the escort and take the archive.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.text: Power is failing across the basin. Reclaim generators and survive the Lattice blackout protocol.

lines.speaker: lattice
lines.text: Power is a privilege. We revoked it.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: Second blackout wave. Protect the new generators.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.text: The extraction intelligence has built a fortress around the archive core. Advance to Singularity and bring it down.

lines.speaker: foundry
lines.text: Walkers will break on this perimeter.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: Singularity unlocked. Siege Walkers are cleared for deployment.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.text: The Lattice is rewriting the old network. Capture its relays, hold the sites, and prevent a total takeover.

lines.speaker: lattice
lines.text: You are already indexed. Resistance is latency.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: Network mapped. Hold the sites through the rewrite window.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.text: Every surviving archive points to one final choice: preserve the past, or become something new.

lines.speaker: lattice
lines.text: You were always a draft. We are the published version.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: Singularity reached. The command network is exposed.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: Core under attack.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: Unit destroyed.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: Structure lost.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: Research complete.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: Construction complete.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: Insufficient resources.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: Compute limit reached.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: Objective complete.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.text: Transmission complete. The collective holds.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: Signal lost. Withdraw if you can.
